title: messaging.py body size check uses character count, not bytes
description: Line 388 in python/src/lichen/coap/resources/messaging.py checks `len(body["body"]) > MESSAGES_MAX_BODY_SIZE` but len() on a string counts characters, not bytes. The constant MESSAGES_MAX_BODY_SIZE is defined as 'max message body/text size in bytes' (line 27). A message with 1024 multi-byte UTF-8 characters (e.g., emoji or CJK text) would pass the check but could be up to 4KB when encoded, exceeding the intended 1024-byte limit. Fix: use `len(body["body"].encode("utf-8")) > MESSAGES_MAX_BODY_SIZE`
